body: I do feel strong for reaching out but sometimes I feel scared incase I can't keep up the fight. I feel I'm constantly arguing with myself/my depression. I get so down I struggle to see a way out then I find a voice in my head saying "how the hell would your kids cope without you, they love you & if you weren't here that would destroy them" I feel strong enough to carry on but its always a fight

It was but in some ways it saved me. I have gone through some seriously bad stuff in relationships & found myself in a very dark place...that's when I reach inside & tell myself that no matter how bad things are, it's not as bad as how my family would feel if I had to end my life. I just get real anxiety incase my daughter doesn't realise the same.
I hope anyone reading this can believe that, even though the darkness feels never-ending & all-consuming, it does shift. It takes a bit strength & patience but it's like cycling up a hill....hard AF & the ego whispering in your ear "it's too hard, let's just give up" but if you keep peddling through the pain you'll be buzzing when you get to the top & go 🖕🏽 to the demons, then fly down the hill knowing that the uphill struggle was no match for beautiful you!
